about_the_game:
1.Open the "Endless Mode"

Players will take on the role of a fortress commander, face an endless stream of alien enemies, and take "holding positions and resisting attacks" as the core goal to fully experience the combat logic from initial defense line construction to mid-term mobile counterattacks.

2. Controllable Battlefield Modules

The Demo only unlocks the basic functions of the three core battlefields, as follows:

  • Defense Line Deployment: Only 1 type of short-range defense facility and 1 type of long-range defense facility can be used to meet basic defense needs;

  • Mobile Counterattack: Only the basic mecha of the "Guoke" mobile unit can be controlled to carry out the task of breaking through the enemy's front;

Resource Game: Supports dispatching ultra-mobile mining vehicles to collect titanium ore, which can be used for basic defense line construction and weapon unlocking. However, the "exclusive conversion of rare ore types" function in the full version is not available for the time being.

3. Unlockable Enemy Types

Only 2 types of basic enemy units exclusive to the Demo are included — the "Poison Fang" ground mecha and the "Space Eater" flying mecha. The BOSS-level units in the full version are not available for the time being.

4. Demo Experience Limitation Description

The Endless Mode has no "clear end". When the player's position is completely destroyed by the enemy, the current experience will end.

short_description: On the cosmic frontier, humanity has fought alien species for a century. As traditional defenses fall to new-gen alien mechs, tech giant ShellMobile—human-centered at its core—kindles new hope via breakthroughs in extraterrestrial titanium ore research.
